name: LFTD Partners Inc.
summary: LFTD Partners Inc., operating through its subsidiary Lifted Made, specializes in the production and distribution of two distinct product lines. The first consists of psychedelic products, marketed under their Silly Shruum brand. The second encompasses hemp-derived cannabinoid products, which they sell under the Urb Finest Flowers label. Established in 1986, the company was previously known as Acquired Sales Corp. before officially rebranding to LFTD Partners Inc. in September 2021. Its corporate headquarters are located in Jacksonville, Florida.
